name: Hornero Weather
description: Dashboard card and contextual bar indicator complementing native Weather with configurable density, a local wind-threshold alert and forecast detail from the PluginKit Weather facade only
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Collapse hidden wind chip container, guard nullable weather fields, and clean copy
Catalogue description no longer leads with an internal version; it says what the extension does first.
Absorbs Sun Card: day length, next sun event and daylight progress on the card (showSunProgress) and a sunrise/sunset bar indicator (barIndicator = sun).
Plain wording in footnotes and labels (no internal terms).
Bar indicator: cloud glyph plus temperature; glyph only without data.
PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: tokens and variant names ported.

Weather & Astronomy 2.0: dashboard card plus contextual bar indicator, configurable density and forecast days, local high-wind threshold alert, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog. Only PluginKit Weather fields are shown; official alerts and multi-location are not exposed by the facade and are labelled unavailable.
Dashboard card for current weather and forecast from the PluginKit Weather service, with a not-configured state instead of fake data.

forecastDays.description: Forecast entries to show (the 1.x card showed the first 3).

showHumidity.description: Show relative humidity when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showWind.description: Show wind speed in km/h when the Weather facade reports it (the 1.x behaviour).

showSunTimes.description: Show sunrise and sunset times from the Weather facade (the 1.x behaviour).

dataDensity.description: compact shows only temperature and description; standard keeps the 1.x rows; detailed adds the derived forecast range.

windAlertKmh.description: Local high-wind alert threshold in km/h. Not an official alert; 1.x had no threshold.

showSunProgress.description: Dashboard: show day length, the next sun event and daylight progress (derived from today's sunrise and sunset).

barIndicator.description: What the bar indicator shows: the temperature, or sunrise and sunset times.
